findings.evidence: "Enter the updated threshold value in the field provided and confirm the unit matches the metric in use."
findings.fix: Specify the field name or location (e.g., "In the Threshold field, enter...") and provide an example threshold value like "100" or "1000".

findings.evidence: "Open the alerts panel from the console sidebar and select the rule you want to adjust."
findings.fix: Add a reference to a UI location or specify the steps more clearly, such as "Open the [application name] console, then click the Alerts icon in the left sidebar."
findings.violation: Readers may not know what the "console sidebar" looks like or where it is located in the interface.

findings.evidence: "This is because the console applies the new threshold to every future evaluation of this rule."

findings.evidence: "Save the rule and open the rule list to confirm the new threshold appears there."
findings.fix: Specify the exact steps: "Click Save, then navigate to [location] to verify the threshold is updated."
findings.violation: The instructions assume the user knows where the rule list is and how to open it.
